$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the VSM ring system — used by the logo generator (brand/generator/ringed.mjs) AND the 3D scene (src/scene/Orrery.ts), so the logo and the interactive site rings are the same rings. Ring i belongs to division i (src/config/site.ts order). Distances are multiples of the word's half-width. Planet angles (0° = right end, 90° = nearest the viewer, 180° = left end): back-side planets sit only at the ring ends, outside the word, so none is hidden; front-side planets sit below the letters, so none cuts a letter.
